name: Doorway Chest Stretch
steps: Stand in a doorway with one foot forward and your forearms resting on the walls to either side.
Shift forward until you feel a gentle stretch across your chest.
Hold the position while breathing evenly, then step back to release.
tips: Keep your lower ribs down as your chest moves forward.
Stop at a mild, comfortable stretch without forcing your shoulders forward or pinching the front joint.
